content.title: Satixfy Communications price target raised to $3 from $2.10 at Alliance Global Partners
content.summary: Alliance Global Partners raised the firm’s price target on Satixfy Communications (SATX) to $3 from $2.10 and keeps a Neutral rating on the shares after the company and MDA Space (MDALF) agreed to amend the take out price to $3 per share after a third party made a bid. Satixfy has committed to not consider any other acquisition proposals, notes the analyst, who points out that shares are now trading at close to the higher take out price. content.title: Telesat signs $39M contract with Satixfy Communications
content.summary: Telesat (TSAT) announced that SatixFy Communications (SATX) will develop and deliver the Landing Station Baseband Units for the upcoming Telesat Lightspeed Network. Under the terms of a new agreement, SatixFy will design, develop, and supply Landing Station Baseband systems to Telesat, with deliveries taking place over a 28-month period. content.summary: SatixFy Communications (SATX) has released an update.
